name: sylament/support
description: Sylament support — shared foundations for the Sylament UI bundles: closure evaluation, the component base, icons, and the styling runtime

suggest.league/flysystem: The storage contract FilesystemRegistry hands out; sylament/forms requires it for file uploads.
suggest.league/flysystem-bundle: Wires named storages under flysystem.storages; FilesystemRegistry resolves them by that name.
